messages:
Ryan: Kicking off deploy for feature/latency-cache to canary at 09:30 PT. ETA ~8m. @Maya you'll own the post-deploy verification? I'll be on standby if we need to rollback.

DeployBot: Deploy started • id=deploy-4962 • image=latency-cache:rev-2

Maya: Yep, I'm on it. Running the quick sweep now. Will post pass/fail per check.

Maya: Quick checks I'm running:
```bash
# health
curl -sS -f https://canary.internal.redwood/v1/health

# simple perf (10 reqs)
hey -n 10 -c 2 https://canary.internal.redwood/generate
```

Sasha: I'll watch the perf dashboard: /dash/infra/canary-latency (p50/p95) and the error-rate panel. Sending a screenshot if anything spikes.

Juan: Rollback plan if needed:
- Command: `rctl rollback --id deploy-4962`
- Contact: @OpsOnCall (pager) then run the rollback, then toggle routing to stable pool.

Maya: Results:
- health: 200 OK ✅
- smoke generate: 10/10 responses
- p50: 46ms, p95: 210ms (within expected) :thumbsup:
- errors: 0.3% (no spike)

Maya: No config drift, KV cache warmed on 3 nodes.

Ryan: Thanks team. We'll keep a 15m watch. If nothing weird, promote to 25% at +20m.

DeployBot: Deploy complete • status=SUCCESS • duration=6m12s
